_doc: battle_tents (hill rooms helper, 2026-10-18; work/agents/battle_tents/tools/rooms_hill.py writes this file): TrainerHill_1F (Emerald's Trainer Hill, notes/BATTLE_TENTS.md), Emerald only (data/versions.json rooms: "emerald"; zone claimed in data/emerald/hoenn_interiors.json). Positions are Emerald tiles; room origin [1, 1] (zone tile = Emerald tile + origin). NPC uid = Emerald local id; scripts, texts and the map scripts are battle_tents'. The other modes' layouts are alt rooms on the same frame (same origin, warps, camera): loaded while their map replace event is set (the lead's zone init).
